sources.entry: Ipic.ai - Ipic.ai is a free AI image generator that can effortlessly create unique AI art. #free

summary.name: iPic.Ai
summary.one_liner: iPic.Ai is a web-based AI image generator that turns short text prompts into art, illustrations, and photos.
use_cases: create illustrations for articles or books
make marketing or social media visuals
produce concept art or design ideas
summary.what_it_does: ["Lets you enter a few words and produces art, illustrations, or photos from the text prompt. ", "Offers an AI Art Gallery to browse existing creations. ", "The page's text is mostly general FAQ content about AI image generators (GANs, VAEs) and tips, not details of the tool's specific controls. ", "Says generated images may be used in your projects if you follow its terms of use, but you may not claim ownership; images remain the property of ipic.ai or its licensors."]
notable: Text-to-image generation with no listed design skills required
Public AI Art Gallery of creations
Generated images may be used in projects under its terms, but remain owned by ipic.ai or its licensors
caveats: Image ownership stays with ipic.ai or its licensors; use is subject to its terms of use
Page does not describe paid tiers or limits; the 'free' label comes from the directory listing
